# DownGo

> DownGo is a download manager for Windows and Linux, developed by Rafix Technologies. This file summarizes the official website and links to its main product, help, and policy pages.

## About DownGo

The Windows edition is available through the Microsoft Store. The Linux page provides a Debian package for compatible 64-bit Debian-based systems. Features and availability depend on the product edition and version. Download speed, resume support, and available media streams depend on the source, host, device, and network.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://downgo.online/): Product overview and current announcements.
- [Features and screenshots](https://downgo.online/features.html): Windows edition features and app screenshots.
- [Windows download](https://downgo.online/download.html): Information about getting DownGo through the Microsoft Store.
- [Linux download](https://downgo.online/linux-download-manager.html): Linux package and installation steps for compatible 64-bit Debian-based systems.
- [Browser integration](https://downgo.online/browser-extension.html): Supported browser integration information.
- [Free vs Pro](https://downgo.online/free-vs-pro.html): Plan and feature comparison.
- [Changelog](https://downgo.online/changelog.html): Product release notes.
- [Roadmap](https://downgo.online/coming-soon.html): Planned and upcoming work.
